data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 557's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 was GBP 27.076m. During the calendar year the syndicate recorded a prior-year surplus (favourable development) of GBP 1.9m relating to the reassessment of prior accident years (net). This release reduced prior-year carried claims and was driven by favourable claims development on prior years. The syndicate experienced increased catastrophe activity in 2016 (notably the Canadian Wildfires and Hurricane Matthew), but these did not produce large losses for Syndicate 557 and the net prior-year reassessment remained a modest release.
raw_causal_phrases: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 1.9m (2015: GBP 2.4m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.

2016 saw an increase in catastrophe activity compared to recent years, with the occurrence of the Canadian Wildfires and Hurricane Matthew. Neither of these events, however, produced a large loss for us, resulting in a satisfactory performance for the year.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure was found in the notes. The report explicitly states a NET surplus of GBP 1.9m relating to prior accident years; per instructions this NET figure has been used as a last-resort fallback and flagged. A gross claims development triangle is present (gross), which could be used to compute a gross PYD but would require diagonal comparisons; given the explicit NET sentence the NET value was used. Users should treat the prior_year_development_gbp_m as NET of reinsurance due to lack of a gross prior-years movement disclosure.
